source_snapshot: OpenNeuro ds003775 v1.2.1 / Git tag 1.2.1 / commit cb354b249827d17fa0575b2b42521ba25982c16b
selection_rule: The complete 42-subject repeat-session roster was established from source metadata only. Lexicographically first 8 are P0-D pilot; remaining 34 are reserved without EEG inspection for prospective P0-Q repeatability qualification after the Atlas reconstruction method/version and any claim-specific scoring rule are frozen.
access_rule: Pilot workflows may retrieve only the 8 development subjects. Reservoir EEG may not be downloaded, parsed, summarized, visualized, or used for tuning until an explicit P0-Q qualification freeze references the reconstruction version and scoring/adjudication rule.
allowed_before_unblinding: source version and annex-identity verification without downloading EEG content
method derivation and software testing on synthetic/non-reservoir data
pilot analysis limited to the eight development subjects
failure_consequence: If the pilot motivates a method/rule change, create a new version and freeze it before any reservoir EEG is opened. If reservoir evidence is accidentally accessed early, mark the affected records non-independent and do not use them as prospective P0-Q evidence.
